responsibility: Declares the COBOL front end’s symbol-table types, semantic enums, and symbol/query APIs. It exposes dialect and feature flags, field/type classification helpers, program/data/file/procedure lookup and insertion functions, register accessors, picture and currency helpers, call-convention tracking, and many semantic utility declarations that tie together scanning, parsing, semantic analysis, and code generation around a shared symbol representation.
same_name_distinction: Defines the symbol-table-facing types, enums, inline predicates, and broad API used across the front end; unlike symbols.cc, it is the shared declaration contract rather than the symbol-table implementation.
